notes.title: Update notes for v2.5
notes.content:
Made all shops sell termites
 Swapped Orangutan's "Hide" skill with Bonobo's "Condescend" skill for better balancing
 Made some of Orangutan's moves stronger
 Reduced "Gorilla Slam" skill's damage and increased stun chance
 Fixed bug where mutants in the Lab dungeon could block certain passageways
 Made most enemies no longer immune to status effects
 Decreased some enemies' health
 Made Flesh Tunnels quiz game less unfair
 Added more hot springs
 Moved the hot spring tutorial sign in Passageway Cavern to the start of the game
 Fixed bug where spiders in Passageway Cavern couldn't collide with player
 Made all optional fights fleeable
 Moved water at the start of Ape Sanctuary dungeon back a little
 Made Bonobo's "Cheer Up" skill heal fully and "Cheeraga" skill heal 50%
 Made Gorilla's "Great Ape Swipe" skill better
 Changed some dialogue to make the game funnier and easier to understand
